root.label: National Capital Planning Commission approves White House visitor screening facility plans

events.label: National Capital Planning Commission approves White House visitor screening facility plans

slots.name: approval status
slots.sentence: The plans were approved by all members of the commission, which includes representatives appointed by Washington Mayor Muriel Bowser, a Democrat.

slots.name: facility occupancy
slots.sentence: The space will also allow significant indoor queuing for large events, with a 700-person occupancy within the screening facility.

slots.name: commission size
slots.sentence: The National Capital Planning Commission on Thursday unanimously voted to approve building plans for a new White House Visitor Screening Facility.
